뒤섞인 요구를 다음 안전한 워크플로로 정리해줘: 비정형 실험 로그로 흐름 만들기
맥락: 로그에는 샘플 ID, 작업자 의견, 결과 주장이 섞였고 일부 기록에는 시각이 없다.
산출물: 근거 필드와 시각 누락 검토 보류가 있는 입력 흐름
작업자 의견을 측정 결과로 다루지 않는다.
열린 질문과 관련된 건 비정형 실험 로그로 흐름 만들기 - [raw]: 메모 로그에는 샘플 ID, 작업자 의견, 결과 주장이 섞였고 일부 기록에는 시각이 없어 / 결과 근거 필드와 시각 누락 검토 보류가 있는 입력 흐름 / 없는 정보는 표시해줘
빠진 사실이 있으면 초안을 되돌릴 수 있게 남겨줘.

Turn these messy requirements into a safe workflow for a workflow from unstructured experiment logs. Context: Logs mix sample IDs, operator comments, and result claims; timestamps are missing for some entries. Deliver: a structured intake with evidence fields and a review hold for missing timestamps. Do not treat an operator comment as a measured result.

i have an open question about a workflow from unstructured experiment logs - raw text: logs mix sample IDs, operator comments, and result claims; timestamps are missing for some entries / need: a structured intake with evidence fields and a review hold for missing timestamps / no invented details pls
Keep the quick draft reversible when a fact is missing.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a workflow from unstructured experiment logs.
Do not treat an operator comment as a measured result.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a workflow from unstructured experiment logs.
Do not treat an operator comment as a measured result.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
